{{Quote|I hope you'll be as careful with the shipment of Tedonian wine as Tohrm was.|Ackmena, speaking in code to Blink|<ref name="Allies" />}}
'''Tedonian wine''' was a type of [[Wine/Legends|wine]]<ref name="Allies" /> that originated in the [[Tedonia system/Legends|Tedonia system]].<ref name="EAOC" /><ref name="Planetnamia" /> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> the name "Tedonian wine" was used to cover the true subject of a conversation between the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Blink]] and a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] named [[Ackmena/Legends|Ackmena]] held in a [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in the [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]. Ackmena said that she hoped Blink would be cautious while delivering shipments of Tedonian wine, as their comrade [[Tohrm]] had been. Ackmena, Blink, and Tohrm were actually part of [[Freedom Flight]], an organization helping to free [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved individuals]], and "Tedonian wine" was the code-name for those they helped.<ref name="Allies" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tedonian wine was mentioned in the novel ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]'', which was written by [[Christie Golden]] and published in [[2010]] as the fifth volume in the ''[[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi]]'' series.<ref name="Allies" />
